name: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 / EN 16931 invoice (0.2.0: adds BR-02, BR-03, BR-05, BR-15 presence, BR-CO-14 and PEPPOL-EN16931-R051; tells an unreadable total from an absent one)

LINE_ALLOWANCE.term: Σ BT-136 Invoice line allowance amount (cac:InvoiceLine/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:Amount, ChargeIndicator false)

LINE_CHARGE.term: Σ BT-141 Invoice line charge amount (cac:InvoiceLine/cac:AllowanceCharge/cbc:Amount, ChargeIndicator true)

SUM_LINE_NET.term: BT-106 Sum of Invoice line net amount (cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount)
labels: Sum of Invoice line net amount

ALLOWANCE.term: BT-107 Sum of allowances on document level (cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:AllowanceTotalAmount)
labels: Sum of allowances on document level

CHARGE.term: BT-108 Sum of charges on document level (cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:ChargeTotalAmount)
labels: Sum of charges on document level

TAX_EXCL.term: BT-109 Invoice total amount without VAT (cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount)

TAX_INCL.term: BT-112 Invoice total amount with VAT (cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount)

AMOUNT_CURRENCY.term: the currencyID the totals are stated in (@currencyID on cac:LegalMonetaryTotal amounts; PEPPOL-EN16931-R051)

VBD_TAX_1.term: BT-117 VAT category tax amount, breakdown row 1 (cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount)

VBD_TAX_2.term: BT-117 VAT category tax amount, breakdown row 2 (cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount)

VBD_TAX_3.term: BT-117 VAT category tax amount, breakdown row 3 (cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount)

VBD_TAX_4.term: BT-117 VAT category tax amount, breakdown row 4 (cac:TaxTotal/cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount)

checks.name: BR-CO-10: BT-106 = Σ BT-131, exact to the cent [PEPPOL-RULES-CEN, CEN-SCH]

fail.detail: re-read BT-106 ({asserted}) and every line net amount BT-131 (they sum to {expected}) off the document; a misread digit is the common cause on a scan
if both are read correctly the invoice breaks BR-CO-10 (fatal in the CEN schematron) by {variance}: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it

checks.name: BR-CO-13: BT-109 = BT-106 − BT-107 + BT-108, exact to the cent [PEPPOL-RULES-CEN, CEN-SCH]

fail.detail: re-read BT-109 ({asserted}), BT-106, BT-107 and BT-108 (BT-106 − BT-107 + BT-108 = {expected}) off the document; a misread digit is the common cause on a scan
if all four are read correctly the invoice breaks BR-CO-13 (fatal in the CEN schematron) by {variance}: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it

checks.name: BR-CO-15: BT-112 = BT-109 + BT-110, exact to the cent; BT-110 is required [PEPPOL-RULES-CEN, CEN-SCH]

fail.detail: re-read BT-112 ({asserted}), BT-109 and BT-110 (BT-109 + BT-110 = {expected}) off the document; a misread digit is the common cause on a scan
if all three are read correctly the invoice breaks BR-CO-15 (fatal in the CEN schematron) by {variance}: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it

checks.name: BR-CO-16: BT-115 = BT-112 − BT-113 + BT-114, exact to the cent [PEPPOL-RULES-CEN, CEN-SCH]

fail.detail: re-read BT-115 ({asserted}), BT-112, BT-113 and BT-114 (BT-112 − BT-113 + BT-114 = {expected}) off the document; a misread digit is the common cause on a scan
if all four are read correctly the invoice breaks BR-CO-16 (fatal in the CEN schematron) by {variance}: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it

checks.name: PEPPOL-EN16931-R120: BT-131 = BT-129 × (BT-146 / BT-149) + Σ BT-141 − Σ BT-136, slack 0.02 [PEPPOL-RULES-PEPPOL, PEPPOL-SCH]
checks.guard_reason: the line lists its allowances/charges as items; this ruleset reads only their totals (line_allowance_amount / line_charge_amount), so it cannot sum Σ BT-136 / Σ BT-141 here

fail.detail: re-read line {line}'s net amount ({asserted}), quantity, price, base quantity, allowance and charge (they give {expected}) off the document
if they are read correctly, line {line} breaks PEPPOL-EN16931-R120 (fatal) by {variance}, beyond its 0.02 slack: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it

checks.name: BR-02: An Invoice shall have an Invoice number (BT-1) [CEN-SCH, assert BR-02: normalize-space(cbc:ID) != '']. Presence only: an absent BT-1 abstains (FIELD_MISSING); a value is not checked for being the right one

abstain.detail: the invoice number (BT-1) as the document prints it; BR-02 makes it mandatory, so if the document has none it is not a compliant EN 16931 invoice and only the seller can issue one that is

checks.name: BR-03: An Invoice shall have an Invoice issue date (BT-2) [CEN-SCH, assert BR-03: normalize-space(cbc:IssueDate) != '']. Presence only

abstain.detail: the issue date (BT-2) as the document prints it; BR-03 makes it mandatory, so if the document has none it is not a compliant EN 16931 invoice and only the seller can issue one that is

checks.name: BR-05: An Invoice shall have an Invoice currency code (BT-5) [CEN-SCH, assert BR-05: normalize-space(cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode) != '']. Presence only

abstain.detail: the invoice currency code (BT-5) as the document states it; BR-05 makes it mandatory, so if the document has none it is not a compliant EN 16931 invoice and only the seller can issue one that is

checks.name: BR-15: An Invoice shall have the Amount due for payment (BT-115) [CEN-SCH, assert BR-15: exists(cbc:PayableAmount)]. Presence only

abstain.detail: the amount due for payment (BT-115) as the document prints it; BR-15 makes it mandatory, so if the document has none it is not a compliant EN 16931 invoice and only the seller can issue one that is

checks.name: PEPPOL-EN16931-R051: All currencyID attributes must have the same value as the invoice currency code (BT-5), except for the invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency (BT-111) [PEPPOL-SCH, assert PEPPOL-EN16931-R051: @currencyID = $documentCurrencyCode]. Read here as: the currency the totals are stated in = the invoice currency code

fail.detail: re-read both codes off the document: the totals are stated in {asserted}, the invoice currency code is {expected}; a misread code is the common cause on a scan, and the VAT total in accounting currency (BT-111) is the one amount allowed another currency
if both codes are read correctly the invoice breaks PEPPOL-EN16931-R051 (fatal): only a corrected invoice from the seller, in one currency, clears it

checks.guard_reason: this ruleset reads at most four VAT breakdown rows by position, and a row whose tax amount was not read cannot be summed
checks.name: BR-CO-14: Invoice total VAT amount (BT-110) = Σ VAT category tax amount (BT-117) [CEN-SCH, assert BR-CO-14 in context cac:TaxTotal: round(sum(cac:TaxSubtotal/cbc:TaxAmount) * 100) div 100], exact to the cent

fail.detail: re-read the VAT total BT-110 ({asserted}) and every VAT breakdown row's tax amount BT-117 (they sum to {expected}) off the document; a misread digit is the common cause on a scan
if all are read correctly the invoice breaks BR-CO-14 (fatal in the CEN schematron) by {variance}: only a corrected invoice from the seller clears it
